answer: Reaching the jade of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, published publicly on failure, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Work waits on the umber until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ridge of the next round. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
